description: DDL adapter for Codex (protocol §2.5). The rule against mutation without approval always applies. After detecting a +++DDL_REPORT and until submitted human input, the gate guards only tool calls covered by the runtime tool hooks. Its catch-all matcher permits known safe reads, human questions, input-free polling, and bounded literal shell reads; mutating calls, unknown tools, and worker follow-ups are denied on those paths. The processor decides whether an actual submitted answer approves the current report and scope. Turn termination remains an instruction; running processes and hook-bypassing transports are outside this guard. Protocol §2.5 records the asynchronous transcript and fail-open limits. SessionStart injects design.md when the hook runs. Project-local configuration requires project trust; user-level hooks are independent of project trust. Review new or changed hooks in /hooks when the runtime requests it. Independently of STOP, the hook denies recognized static noncanonical push forms in confirmation-enabled modes so a canonical invocation can reach native policy. Whether native policy prompts depends on the active settings; report approval remains required. The hook never rewrites commands or grants permission, and does not inspect arbitrary scripts or aliases. The rules live in the skills and protocol and remain instructions where the adapter is absent or cannot enforce them.
